files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:latest
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - DB_PASSWORD=hunter2
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

files.compose.yaml:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready"]
